svg.title: Mem0: facts in a vector store
svg.desc: Mem0's architecture, with the running example. Writing: each session goes to an extractor, one model call per add(), which sees related stored facts and returns new facts to add. Memory: a vector store of nine short facts; the old and the new diet are both kept. Reading: the question is embedded and every fact is scored; all nine go into the prompt, and the answer covers every constraint.
